title: Transpacific Industries Group Ltd - acquisition of One Stop Garbage Shop Pty Ltd
targets: One Stop Garbage Shop Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC decided not to oppose the acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Transpacific purchased the business and assets of One Stop Garbage Shop Pty Ltd.
body_sections.Market definition: Relevant markets for the purpose of this competition assessment were the supply of commercial bins in Victoria and for the supply of plastic bins in Australia.
body_sections.Competition analysis: On 29 April 2008 the ACCC formed the view that the acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition in the relevant markets.  Factors informing this view included: - the availability of supply from WasteTech, KS Environmental, Sulo and other competing suppliers of commercial bins; and - the availability of supply of plastic bins including wheelibins from domestic and overseas sources such as Sulo, Nylex and Mastec. Accordingly, the ACCC decided not to oppose the acquisition.
